newsitem.title: POLAND: KPW clears U.S.-Polish Przymierze aggressive fund.
newsitem.headline: KPW clears U.S.-Polish Przymierze aggressive fund.

text.p: The Polish-U.S. mutual fund company Przymierze Towarzystwo Funduszy Powierniczych SA has received the approval of the Polish securities commission (KPW) to launch an aggressive fund, KPW head Jacek Socha said.
The fund has said it plans to launch its Eurofundusz 2 aggressive fund in April and a debt instrument fund at mid-1997.
Przymierze's balanced fund, Eurofundusz 1, started selling units in September last year and seeks to gain an asset value of about 200 million zlotys, or 50,000 to 60,000 accounts, by the end of 1997.
Przymierze is 51-percent owned by Polish state-owned Bank Pekao SA and 49-percent owned by the U.S.'s Alliance Capital Management LP. (( -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700 ))
